decodedPurpose: Analytics/telemetry sink killswitch - disables all telemetry data transmission
description: Controls the telemetry sink pipeline. When disabled (killswitch triggered), all analytics events are silently dropped before reaching the telemetry endpoint. This is the master killswitch for all Claude Code telemetry.

decodedPurpose: Voice mode emergency killswitch - disables voice input/output
description: Emergency killswitch for voice mode. Note the '_disabled' suffix: when this flag evaluates to true, voice mode is disabled. This is an inverted killswitch pattern - the flag name itself indicates the disabled state.

Controls access to the agent teams (multi-agent swarm) feature. Requires BOTH the GrowthBook flag AND a corresponding environment variable to be enabled - a dual-gate pattern for extra safety. Without both conditions met, agent teams remain unavailable.

decodedPurpose: Auto dream - automatic memory consolidation feature
description: Gates the auto-dream feature which performs automatic memory consolidation. When enabled, Claude Code can automatically consolidate and organize information from conversation history into persistent memory without explicit user action.
Controls access to the memory directory (memdir) feature. Memdir provides structured, file-based persistent memory for Claude Code sessions. This flag gates the overall feature availability.
A secondary switch for the memdir feature that controls specific memdir behavior or mode. Works in conjunction with tengu_coral_fern (the primary gate) and tengu_slate_thimble (another switch).
Controls the team memory feature which enables shared memory across team members. When enabled, memory entries can be synchronized and shared within an organization or team context.
Gates a path-related feature. The 'passport' prefix suggests this may relate to path resolution, navigation, or file traversal capabilities within Claude Code.
Another memdir switch that works alongside tengu_moth_copse and tengu_coral_fern. Part of the multi-flag gating strategy for the memory directory system.

decodedPurpose: Away summary feature - generates summaries while user is away
description: Controls the away summary feature. When enabled, Claude Code generates a summary of work completed during long-running operations or while the user is away from the terminal.

Controls whether fast mode (internally called 'penguin mode') is disabled. When this flag is active, fast mode is turned off. Can be set remotely via the /api/claude_code_penguin_mode endpoint, making it a remotely-controllable killswitch.
Secondary control for fast mode rollout. Works alongside tengu_penguins_off to manage the gradual rollout and availability of fast mode across the user base.

decodedPurpose: Model override for internal testing - allows switching underlying model
description: Internal-only flag that allows Anthropic engineers to override the model used by Claude Code. The 'ant' prefix suggests Anthropic-internal scope. This enables A/B testing of different model versions without requiring a client update.

Controls the verification agent feature. When enabled, a secondary agent can be invoked to verify claims, check code correctness, or validate outputs produced by the primary agent. The 'hive' prefix suggests collective/swarm verification, 'evidence' indicates proof-based checking.
